definitions.explanation: A substance applied to metal to keep it from rusting or corroding. It comes as sprays, oils, and coatings.

examples.japanese: {金属|きんぞく}に{防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}を{塗|ぬ}る。
examples.english: I apply rust preventative to the metal.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}のチェーンに{防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}をスプレーした。
examples.english: I sprayed rust preventative on the bicycle chain.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{近|ちか}くでは{錆|さ}びやすいので、{車|くるま}の{下回|したまわ}りに{防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}を{施|ほどこ}した。
examples.english: Things rust easily near the sea, so I applied rust preventative to the underbody of the car.

notes:
Composed of {防錆|ぼうせい} (rust prevention) + {剤|ざい} (agent, preparation). The suffix {剤|ざい} forms the names of chemical agents and preparations.

USAGE:
- {防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}を{塗|ぬ}る: to apply rust preventative
- {防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}をスプレーする: to spray on rust preventative

RELATED WORDS:
- {錆|さび}: rust
- {錆止|さびど}め: rust prevention; rustproofing — a more everyday equivalent of {防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}
